name: v1.4.263
body:
[Previous release: 1.4.262](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.262) — Faster chat switching, lower memory use and git blame.

## Lighter chat startup, Hermes in Chat & browser extension side panels ✨

Reopen workspaces full of chats with less memory use and less startup work. Restored chat interfaces load when first shown, and Orca no longer rewrites every saved conversation at launch. Opened chats keep their drafts and scroll position when you return.

- 💬 **Continue Hermes conversations in Chat:** Start Hermes from the New Tab menu, or choose **Resume in New Chat** on a Session History entry to continue a terminal conversation in its original workspace and profile.
- 🌐 **Keep extensions beside your page:** Chrome extensions that use side panels can now open in a resizable panel in Orca's browser. Click the extension's toolbar button to use its panel while browsing; extension popups also accept Paste, Copy and Select All.
- 🖥️ **Reach your remote work:** Managed SSH ports now have a **Forward** button. On Windows, projects opened through a mapped WSL drive letter can move onto their distro's WSL host.
- ⌨️ **Keep terminal output in view after a restart:** On macOS and Linux, a terminal whose shell stopped can restore its saved output with the new prompt below it. Windows keeps its existing restore behavior.

## Highlights

- **Connect Linear from the command line:** `orca linear connect` accepts an API key through stdin and connects the host you target, including a headless server. Each host keeps its own connection. Linear issue and project lists now return all results when you omit `--limit`.
- **Set up agents on Windows:** Claude and Codex chats offer **Install** when the agent is missing, then **Check again** to detect the installation. `orca agent installed` also lists enabled agent CLIs on the current host for scripts and launch setup.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Hermes:** Chat requires Hermes 0.23.0 or later on the machine running the workspace. Very long imports show recent messages while Hermes retains the full conversation. Chat is unavailable for SSH workspaces; a paired Orca server supports it. The first chat after Hermes' gateway stops can take a minute to start.
- **Browser identity:** **Native** is now the default, addressing the Cloudflare verification loop seen with the previous default. Explicit identity choices are preserved; change yours in Settings → Browser → Browser identity.
- **Phone updates:** The phone UI changes listed below require a corresponding mobile build. This desktop update does not update Android or iOS apps.

## Known issues

- **Sleep workspace instead:** The option can fail when another tab in that workspace is running a process.
- **`orca agent installed --worktree`:** The command errors on SSH and paired-server workspaces.

---

## What's Changed

### 📱 Phone & mobile

*Phone source changes for agent launch choices, text size, quoted replies, pairing and connections. These require a corresponding mobile build.*

* Preserve unchanged sections in large diffs by @kia378 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42893
* Refuse a desktop access link when pairing a phone by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43289
* Keep a slow link open through iOS network-change checks by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43314
* Quote a selected passage of an agent reply into the chat box by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43324
* Change chat and terminal text size from the session menu by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43334
* Choose Chat or CLI when starting an agent from the phone by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43340
* Say the host can't stream browser tabs instead of asking for a desktop update by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43361
* Size the terminal once when it starts with a bundled font by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43410
* Say "host" instead of "desktop" in phone copy and tell same-email Codex logins apart by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43804

### 💬 Chat & session history

*Hermes in Chat, suggested next prompts, steadier steering and restarts, and fewer stuck or lost conversations.*

* Keep Claude follow-ups in the current reply when their echo ID changes by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/37925
* Run Hermes Agent in Chat over its ACP server by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42895
* Show Claude's suggested next prompt in the empty composer by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42907
* Keep Chat sends from merging with or stranding text in the agent's input line by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43141
* Setting to turn off spellcheck and autocorrect in the chat composer by @jagritvats in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43198
* Reopen Codex chats archived in Codex and never silently replace a used conversation by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43283
* Apply permission mode changes to the running chat by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43290
* Give Chat UI Claude in Chrome browser tools when "Enabled by default" is on by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43308
* Say a conversation was saved in another folder instead of offering a Retry that can't work by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43331
* Show Hermes sessions from state.db in Session History by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43343
* Show the usage-limit notice as one compact row by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43345
* Open a Hermes Session History row as a new chat by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43370
* Cmd/Ctrl+Enter steer shows as sent, not as a queued card first by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43392
* List agent models before the first chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43411
* Retain skill scopes in the slash picker by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43436
* Pass the chat's model to thread/fork so /btw side chats keep the selected model by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43438
* Ask for the summary context report so a resumed chat makes no token-count API calls by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43441
* Leave chats waiting on you in the restart list instead of auto-resuming them by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43474
* Reload a GitHub link preview when its account binding comes back by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43483
* A non-string host id no longer crashes the terminal workbench by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43499
* Send a queued Steer once the agent can take it instead of refusing by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43513
* Name agents that stay in the terminal when Chat UI becomes the default from the launch tip by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43544
* Recover journal writes after confirmed SQLite rollback by @PeterGuy326 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43560
* Continue moved or copied Grok chats in Chat UI by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43651
* Offer Claude and Codex Install on Windows hosts by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43857

### 🤝 Workers & coordination

*Guidance that points agents to Orca mail, faster delivery of worker reports to busy chats, and clearer worker cards on paired servers.*

* Send messages between agents through Orca mail, not terminal input by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43309
* Stop rebuilding sender history and resending orchestration rows on unchanged graph replies by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43458
* Show check --terminal syntax in terminal worker preamble by @helmipradita in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43502
* Steer other agents' mail into a running turn without waiting on earlier mail by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43694
* Name the receiving terminal in mail wake commands by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43726
* Show the agent on start cards for workers on a paired server by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43745

### 🤖 Agents, models & accounts

*Clearer model, usage and status handling across Antigravity, Kimi, Codex and Hermes, plus a command that lists installed agents.*

* Show remote Codex account usage in account rows by @gentslava in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41540
* Publish sessions across local-date boundaries by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42992
* Submit Windows Muse worker prompts held as pasted content by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43250
* Show Antigravity's empty-output retries as a retrying row by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43257
* List models in the agent picker from the account new chats use by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43363
* Reuse Codex launch preparation from every entry point by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43365
* Shorten usage pool labels and drop duplicate weekly row by @asunghong in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43457
* Add orca agent installed to list installed agent CLIs by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43505
* Don't flash the install screen when chats run the host's agy by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43507
* Drop child subagent lifecycle hooks so they don't complete the root pane by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43672
* Install OpenCode, Pi and Claude agent-view integrations only for agents in use by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43705
* Order effort levels lowest to highest in every selector by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43737
* Show a turn cancelled with Esc as interrupted by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43750
* Show the first prompt in a new Kimi pane as working by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43765
* Start the prompt cache countdown for remote terminals this window never opened by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43773
* Stop re-offering Install Orca's copy once it is installed by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43937
* Run chats on Antigravity ACP server 1.5.0 on every platform by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43938
* Let a healthy host agy serve chats despite a keyring-fallback marker by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43940
* Keep the selected agy account launchable after agy rewrites its login by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43941

### 🧹 Workspace cleanup & lifecycle

*Manual and Automatic cleanup sections with clear rule checks.*

* Manual and Automatic cleanup sections with clear rule checks by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42905
* Stop the terminal daemon and name the orca serve row by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43285

### 🗂️ Workspaces, windows & navigation

*Open Settings with ⌘, on macOS, steadier sidebar and project picking, and clearer delete and tab-bar messages.*

* Open Settings with ⌘, by default on macOS by @Lainaaa in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42778
* Preserve slash-separated workspace branch names by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43171
* Open project pickers beside the newest local project by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43244
* Keep a hidden project's worktrees under a shown folder workspace by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43261
* Show primary worktree delete explanation in tooltip by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43432
* Move hidden new-tab items hint to info tooltip by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43446
* Fit the + menu agent list to the screen and point the simulator tip at the phone by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43481
* Reveal worktrees below both pinned headers when hosts are shown by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43558
* Show "Changes could not be checked" when git status fails in the Delete dialog by @Rudhery in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43689

### ⌨️ Terminals

*Cold-restored terminals keep their output in view, CLI closes stop the process, and the Linux terminal shim updates safely.*

* Read newer saved terminal IDs without losing their bindings by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43098
* Keep a cold-restored terminal's output in view outside Windows by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43349
* Agent status updates stop flooding the desktop with unchanged chat-tab frames by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43350
* A CLI close stops the terminal's process when the window doesn't confirm by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43479
* Replace the Linux terminal shim atomically so running shells never read a half-written script by @dfmcintosh-hash in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43684

* Keep terminal text at its normal size with GPU rendering on the new Electron by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43835

### 🖥️ SSH, WSL & remote hosts

*Forward managed SSH ports, move WSL-drive projects to the WSL host, and many fixes for orcad and paired servers.*

* Resolve Windows drive paths inside the WSL distro for Source Control by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43052
* Preserve path-shaped task prompts in WSL generation by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43168
* Reclaim a dead installer's orcad install lock in seconds by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43336
* Close removal watchers without reauthorizing a revoked worktree path by @hellokaton in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43371
* Retire the renderer tab when closeTerminal's post-stop tab close reports tab_not_found by @tomoyanakano in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43423
* Show older paired clients short branch names again by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43448
* Reject oversized subscription requests instead of killing the shared socket by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43482
* Move projects saved under a mapped WSL drive letter by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43493
* Skip unused background wsl.exe status reads (Claude publish, telemetry) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43496
* Keep loading models when an older WSL host isn't ready yet by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43497
* Close mirrored SSH-host editor tabs on the host when closed from the tab strip by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43506
* Accept "blank" default agent when generating commit messages on WSL/SSH hosts by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43654
* Install the session search scope catalog on orcad hosts by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43702
* Forward button on managed SSH ports, and hide other users' ports on shared hosts by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43733
* Auto-rename workspaces from the first terminal agent prompt on serve and SSH hosts by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43739
* Suggest the paired host's Workspace Directory in Create project by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43746
* Make console and network work on orcad, and find AppImage installs for its browser by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43801
* Show and save a server project's presets on that server by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43812

### 🌐 Browser

*Chrome extension side panels, a Native browser identity by default, and browser commands that stay on the right machine.*

* Support Chrome extension side panels in the built-in browser by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42844
* Route Paste, Copy and Select All to extension popups by @AZEROSTART in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43374
* Tolerate a missing or throwing frame list when classifying guest discard protection by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43408
* Keep agent screencasts painting and route frames to the session that started them by @guido-erdtsieck in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43658
* Gate CLI page commands on main-frame loading, not subframe loading by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43677
* Default the browser identity to Native so Cloudflare checks pass by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43730
* Keep server agents out of desktop files on This-device pages by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43736
* Resolve upload paths from the caller's folder and print screenshot paths a WSL shell can open by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43743
* SSH host browser commands run on the desktop tab or refuse, never in the host's own browser by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43747
* Agent tab profile and screenshot commands on This-device and serve pages by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43755
* Dropping a remote workspace HTML file on a browser page opens it by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43766
* Grey out Back/Forward on server-run pages with no history by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43805

### 🔀 Source control & integrations

*Linear connects on any host, Jira keeps Markdown, and GitHub, glab and Tasks fixes.*

* Retain Markdown when publishing comments and descriptions by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42242
* Explain artifact API rate limits and replay once on a short Retry-After by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42882
* Show other hosts' rows without waiting on an offline paired server by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43273
* Fetch branchName for project and custom view issue lists by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43417
* List every Linear issue and project when --limit is omitted, and report search totals by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43469
* Let single-host multi-repo projects pick an individual task source by @YannVanneth in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43609
* Keep the Jira project filter when leaving and returning to the Tasks view by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43619
* Read saved PR links from their own repository on fork checkouts by @ninecc in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43640
* Read running PR checks when the user returns to Orca by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43690
* Apply the Settings HTTP proxy to glab child processes by @GabrielCousin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43763
* Connect Linear on any Orca host with orca linear connect by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43770

### 📝 Editor & files

*Markdown notes and previews with clearer notes sending and tidier review-note columns.*

* Keep idle agents selectable in Send notes to, never send into approval menus by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42239
* Send the quoted text with every markdown note by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43241
* Drop empty review-note column from list items when review notes are off by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43776

### 🎨 Settings, plugins & languages

*Calmer dialogs and settings highlights, plugin requests that queue instead of failing, and French, Japanese and Korean fixes.*

* Unify confirmation dialog layout and actions by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/42872
* Give loose settings rows room around the jump highlight by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43492
* Queue plugin frame requests past the in-flight cap instead of refusing them by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43554
* Stop footer buttons flashing a thick outline as hover starts by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43583
* Translate the HTML preview 'Open source file' control as an action in fr, ja and ko by @cbenz in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43616

### ⚡ Performance & reliability

*Chat and persistence do less work at startup and on every save, with crash reports for fatal memory failures.*

* Stop restating quiet transcripts and resweeping with purges while indexing a backlog by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40528
* A fatal OOM crashes with a report instead of livelocking; name the worker and payload behind it by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43327
* Resolve one workspace without projecting every workspace in its repo by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43437
* Read large catalog images in batched rounds instead of one Git call per image by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43444
* Stop reopening the GitHub cache database on the main thread every save by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43449
* Mount a chat view only once its tab has been shown by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43516
* Own retained session metadata strings so the scanner stops pinning decoded chunks by @yhdhaidong in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43525
* Run chat readers in their own process; record main's allocation sites before memory runs out by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/43535

body:
[Previous release: 1.4.261](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.261): Major performance improvements, Cursor Chat and a customizable + menu.

## Faster chat switching, lower memory use & git blame ✨

Keep more conversations open with less memory on macOS and Linux, and move between chats with less work happening in hidden views. This update also helps terminal sessions pick up where you left off and puts line history directly in the editor.

- ⚡ **Work across many chats:** Chat UI uses lighter helpers on macOS and Linux. Hidden chat views pause their updates while retaining your draft, reading position and editor state for your return; agents keep working.
- 🧹 **Reclaim disk space:** Settings → Workspace Cleanup can delete Orca, Claude Code and Codex chats from deleted workspaces. It is off by default; enabling it asks for confirmation and includes previously deleted workspaces. Deleted chats cannot be recovered.
- ⌨️ **Return to the same terminal folder:** Panes remember where you last changed directory across restarts, including in folder workspaces. Windows also fixes stray characters after returning to a busy pane.
- 🔍 **See who changed a line:** The Git blame status item shows the cursor line’s author and date. In repo workspaces, click it to open the commit; enable **Inline git blame** in Settings → Editor for annotations beside your code.
- 👤 **Make account switching clearer:** Name saved Claude and Codex accounts and see their last observed plans. When you accept Restart or use Always restart, busy Claude terminal sessions resume on the selected account without waiting for their current work to finish.

## Highlights

- **Set up an agent in one card:** Choose the agent, model and supported effort or Fast options together, then use **Open as chat** or **Open as terminal**. Where offered, **Default** effort lets the agent choose its own level.
- **Control interruptions:** Right-click a workspace to mute its notifications while keeping its unread dot. Sleeping workspaces stay asleep after relaunch, and the workspace-card preview lets you try different styles.
- **Use your language and plugins:** Discover community translations in Settings or onboarding. Plugin update reviews name the added access and can group approvals; eligible updates can be approved from their notification.
- **Save remote files for later:** Choose **Download…** on a remote file link to save it without opening another app. Windows also recognizes project folders on drive letters mapped to WSL distros.
- **Resolve a blocked Codex action:** Chat explains an automatic-review denial and offers **Approve once** for that action.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Codex history sharing:** With sharing enabled, accounts move to one conversation store before their next launch; this may delay the first launch, and busy accounts migrate later. Turning sharing off leaves shared history in place; long conversations started while sharing was on need it enabled to resume. After a Windows downgrade, additional accounts fall back to your default Codex sign-in until you update again.
- **Windows terminals:** Close and reopen existing terminals to pick up the stray-character fix.
- **Repo setup steps:** Earlier `orca.yaml` approvals now count as trust for future versions of that repo’s setup commands. VM creation and repos sharing an ID across hosts keep per-version approval.

---


## What's Changed

name: v0.9.66
body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.66

Released on 2026-11-18.

Studio's sealed preview now takes property edits, crops, resizes and plays slideshow scenes. A preview no longer sits in Buffering when a clip stops downloading, and the player can carry your own branding.

## Features

- **Player:** Add customizable branding to the preview player ([a9b4745f1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a9b4745f1f9773cc0dcd1f6d81b942ce97335f87), [#7718](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7718)).

## Fixes

- **AWS Lambda:** Match the shell to its own pin, ship only hashed files, refuse the shell ZIP in CDK and SAM ([61d65e717](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/61d65e717736eb8918cd99ad1d50be61cbebd986), [#8173](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8173)).
- **AWS Lambda:** Pin the shell ZIP route, gate ZIP headroom, match arm64 fonts to x86 ([ed3f05a05](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ed3f05a05ba21a911236c82f13674b24154d0605), [#8170](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8170)).
- **Studio:** Property panel style and attribute edits show in a sealed preview ([b525686e7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b525686e7ef3759d60d6e9751c487ae1dabb5de1), [#8149](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8149)).
- **Compiler:** Rebase composition asset paths from the file read and charge what they add ([bb55c1ea7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bb55c1ea7efb907da70c3d403b368c74241c8c43), [#8166](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8166)).
- **CLI:** Figma commands print manifest and folder text with visible escapes ([420f14d15](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/420f14d1556f6809dbb607cdc3812e59993e5479), [#8126](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8126)).
- **CLI:** Show control characters in printed names as visible escapes ([3e788fb15](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3e788fb15addd7573c398c5c67a1bd330b842143), [#8008](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8008)).
- **Skills:** The launcher's floor is 0.9.65, the oldest release Desktop ships ([140b70140](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/140b7014034fc4cc977eeb897660b8d4be16fe9c), [#8159](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8159)).
- **AWS Lambda:** Chrome-headless-shell 158 in the arm64 video image, sparticuz 153 in the x86 ZIP ([81d73d227](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/81d73d2278a44ec8fcf2db1979a1c78f7931deed), [#8155](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8155)).
- **Producer:** Inline a local font only while the page stays within its size limit ([3b79b1858](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3b79b1858e2feb1ebc6b549d7e418f697ba1eabc), [#8152](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8152)).
- **Studio:** A sealed preview's element reads are bounded, and a frame with no agent answers at once ([e623031f3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e623031f3a56053b913616969500f13aa9714198), [#8055](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8055)).
- **Core:** Each editing client takes its own port, so a sealed preview answers Studio again ([e95cdf7d7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e95cdf7d76064eb8166a36823a202cf5e0f03859), [#8154](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8154)).
- **Core:** Keep SVG id renaming linear in the page size and within the render size limit ([5bd3e3242](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5bd3e3242c6a768128aea9ac5259e18a11a081e3), [#8147](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8147)).
- **Studio:** Check every file a folder move or delete takes along ([7ea012953](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7ea0129530d1f6274b26da265b94dfb6b49b8b08), [#8143](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8143)).
- **Studio:** A sealed preview takes its film's size from the player ([d574ded1e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d574ded1eca1ca55fabb2ba9f59931a8095fbcbf), [#7967](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7967)).
- **Core:** Keep the styles of a composition whose id contains $ patterns ([12a2f83c4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/12a2f83c49db1730519cf0df8f58e548cda7e8c4), [#8141](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8141)).
- **Compiler:** Bound composition variable styles and variable media sources ([c6e3f30be](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c6e3f30bea553e3a32edd8ae939be69c57346a75), [#8144](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8144)).
- **Core:** A clip that stops downloading no longer holds the preview in Buffering forever ([01331014d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/01331014d883bef324143ef8f2bdcb695afe6924), [#8138](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8138)).
- **Player:** Keep the video playing when you jump to another moment ([3ee095bde](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3ee095bdec4a1c78773b6e7041b6ad3190b0d0c5), [#7719](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7719)).
- **CLI:** Run global updates from the home directory ([e99cd75b4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e99cd75b4228cccee644a4e650db961b5b02f9bf), [#8131](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8131)).
- **Media Use:** Escape control characters in the remaining resolve and cube-validate lines ([9a096d72f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9a096d72f31e4a8a4853ed556d107a43703004db), [#8059](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8059)).
- **Media:** Keep each index.md row on one line and show control characters as escapes ([ebddc4248](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ebddc42486ec251e773770f7743ffe59ad2004cd), [#8127](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8127)).
- **CLI:** Tests read opencv.js from a CI cache, never a CDN mid-test ([e6cee094b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e6cee094b18e64133afdfbf046d3bbf1125a4d6a), [#7968](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7968)).
- **Studio:** Crop and scale resize work in a sealed preview ([c569417bb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c569417bb5aea6942978fbf01f21545ed09b1bac), [#8005](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8005)).
- **Core:** Treat files package managers run by default as tool-trusted ([5f06e1b0a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5f06e1b0a373a5ca0ca39d3b8363dcf1ed8bff96), [#8129](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8129)).
- **Skills:** The launcher never starts a CLI older than its security floor ([63c8f8ef6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/63c8f8ef66e3c5e2dbcfee77923def09cf360112), [#8125](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8125)).
- **CLI:** Say when check's face pass stopped a source at its time limit ([59fbb22eb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/59fbb22ebac388d74c93c038a0b47975be8f7f1f), [#8122](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8122)).
- **CLI:** Media-use scripts read the host's kept record copy as the CLI does ([c27adb35f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c27adb35ffa400a2d526c9c83a5b3d184d1080f8), [#8119](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8119)).
- **Studio:** Slideshow scenes, block stacking, drill-down and shortcuts work in a sealed preview ([80bf6a9dd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/80bf6a9ddb8bd24c2039eeb689fd129b6ecac512), [#8118](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8118)).
- **CLI:** A rename keeps the received-files record listing the moved file ([cb2b51525](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cb2b51525effe2947bf8d3d38d870174a24e05d3), [#8112](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8112)).

## Docs & Examples

- **Ci:** Say the npm-publish environment needs a reviewer's approval ([d94aa5e30](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d94aa5e3094d352ee27a11a407746e8ba2369da4), [#8123](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8123)).

## Internal

- **Producer:** The missing-file render detail added in this cycle was taken out again before release, and returns in a later one ([cfea8cfff](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cfea8cfff5a5f833afac14866b63c290fa59fc5e), [#7955](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7955), [eb7dc14e8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/eb7dc14e89abc9928581b78c0f0df87dcfe89e7f), [#8146](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8146), [94d06663b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/94d06663b114de340cb74f4368936f43810c2850), [#8174](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8174)).
- **Player:** One hung Safari run no longer fails every Safari run after it ([9acf26868](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9acf26868015f359212cb3916db69ac3f9c7aa14), [#8169](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8169)).
- **Studio:** Share one sealed preview frame that delivers messages like a browser ([640cb3792](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/640cb37929ab483b7bc3a26160abeb67add49ed6), [#8165](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8165)).
- **Chrome:** Pin chrome-headless-shell 158.0.8127.36 wherever the repo installs it ([793052502](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7930525024c4c0fcee6f15ed783cd2a52751c29b), [#8145](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8145)).
- **Lint:** Fail when a RegExp is built from text that is not escaped ([dcdd34071](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/dcdd340715024dffb57b65b2aa88c3dc1b8f1780), [#8128](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8128)).

name: v0.9.65
body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.65

Released on 2026-11-17.

Studio's sealed preview now draws motion paths, reads keyframes and keeps a moved layer in place when you add a keyframe. Studio's error and analytics events no longer carry your error text, file paths or selectors.

## Features

- **Studio Server:** Let a host count the requests the API refuses with 403 ([078e54d00](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/078e54d0089f57c9513dbcb5d07ea092f7be907b), [#8049](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8049)).

## Fixes

- **Studio:** Error events send a class, a shape and Studio's own frames, not the error's words ([195aa2f0c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/195aa2f0cdc22149f68576cd6bb88cf1f8c099b3), [#8114](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8114)).
- **Studio:** Add keyframe on a sealed preview keeps a moved layer in place ([ce3decb6b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ce3decb6b5e957cee76b11517a9454e5812e4345), [#8117](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8117)).
- **CLI:** Check's face pass reads only media the page may load ([c4a4167aa](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c4a4167aace1c3aba115ba8505207dfdbc6413f0), [#8116](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8116)).
- **Studio:** A sealed preview moves and saves a layer its animation moves ([7a9d78e69](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7a9d78e69a8d4fd5733a39d156de9d53c0f91223), [#8105](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8105)).
- **Studio:** Analytics send path and selector facts, not the paths and selectors ([d87285387](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d872853874ffd5ff4f6deb28f7421d081774e897), [#8109](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8109)).
- **Studio:** The motion path draws and can be created in a sealed preview ([373d987e3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/373d987e32e7ab76ed916d2249a808b57a678dd9), [#8108](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8108)).
- **Skills:** Select standalone CLI releases through the launcher ([414adffb8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/414adffb82ea07b5b65b81369595b4be17988ff5), [#8102](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8102)).
- **Figma:** Write .media and component outputs without following links ([a765c9379](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a765c937918d67d9b9f5a3564fc59a845f252ab3), [#8111](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8111)).
- **Studio:** The edit bench waits out the preview swap once a plain element gains keyframes ([ba62d7748](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ba62d7748943f2a2cb89e091a9ee50dd95d41489), [#8113](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8113)).
- **CLI:** Windows Chrome cleanup and process reads no longer pass PowerShell command text ([b930c4d2d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b930c4d2d7bcbe985ef5c8fea1ab125c0d5c91bc), [#8085](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8085)).
- **Release:** The no-account pusher check reads its file directly, with no pipe ([740796888](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7407968882c86080bb528af6caef6ac646030ce9), [#8095](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8095)).
- **Producer:** Bound the static media selector check by the page it walks ([435dd0e68](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/435dd0e68507f53bcf6940d2033a53b6f08913eb), [#8091](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8091)).
- **Studio:** A selected element stays drawn and draggable after a sealed preview reloads ([1bf629c1d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1bf629c1d337df2c9fa2250930825569bf0293da), [#8081](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8081)).
- **Studio:** A click after two quick seeks adds the keyframe in a sealed preview ([93622154e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/93622154ef0a0f5256bbd2432f6a92b5999eefea), [#8103](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8103)).
- **Release:** List the MCP server as com.heygen/hyperframes, signed by heygen.com's key ([88ba1b4d7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/88ba1b4d7c9a0a97b136516564513e4d2133b1bb), [#8106](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8106)).
- **Media Use:** Audio scripts judge a received .env by the CLI's rule ([bc5259d2d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bc5259d2d3114a80f91e35b635405efda6f65438), [#8086](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8086)).
- **Media Use:** Write local generator output into private per-run folders ([ac33c1f2b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ac33c1f2bca64956da588693e21eab841a55832a), [#8030](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8030)).
- **Studio:** GSAP keyframe and value reads work in a sealed preview ([133965e4f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/133965e4f52ea8e6a161562f9905177b96227f4c), [#8003](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8003)).
- **CLI:** Keep files received that a host's kept record still lists ([183bf2a41](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/183bf2a416aa7438bef3abd50c9f97376d304e34), [#8100](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8100)).
- **CLI:** Say a listed received file is gone, and drop a media file's line on rename ([4a59fef2d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4a59fef2d0b91de31f97e4a8d9b9071a3e8330c9), [#8098](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8098)).

## Catalog

- Watch the MCP registry hourly for HeyGen listings server.json never held ([0b0108f2f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0b0108f2f630b95d3a39617b5f5b7e6b538d9752), [#8107](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8107)).
- **Registry:** Use the installed launcher in block guides ([1c99314a6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1c99314a62788cb960236102f2f7bc4e022fa178), [#8101](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8101)).

## Internal

name: v0.9.64
body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.64

Released on 2026-11-17.

Hover and thumbnail captures no longer wait on a 4K clip's preview copy. In a sealed preview, scrubbing plays the music track and timeline rows know their element. `hyperframes check` finds text over a face. Studio's proxy refuses requests with no same-site signal. A stable release now needs a second maintainer besides its approver.

## Features

- **CLI:** `check` finds text over a face, `measure` cuts the names of resumed takes, and `measure` reports hands ([820d63d7f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/820d63d7f9e2a5fafc0a0230e8b4c8dc5447d995), [#8074](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8074)).

## Fixes

- **Core:** Hover and thumbnail captures never wait for a 4K clip's preview copy ([f1f8ca31c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f1f8ca31c3dcf752fb4aadb4933f43b903ebd2cd), [#8079](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8079)).
- **Studio:** Timeline rows in a sealed preview know their element, source file and audio group ([cda94eb0f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cda94eb0f63cb81ed8ebc806520fb72ce4cb08c7), [#8078](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8078)).
- **Studio:** Scrubbing the playhead plays the music track in a sealed preview ([a56fa2caf](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a56fa2caf3f34b8fa143912f25924cfdfd9acef5), [#8082](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8082)).
- **CLI, Studio Server:** Refuse `?hf-proxy` when a request carries no same-site signal ([4bea3e79c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4bea3e79c2e30d9f55f3ff5563a42a3bdcca785e), [#8066](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8066)).
- **CLI:** A project `.env` provider key prints a note when it is used ([90de9b619](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/90de9b619695e0cc95250557c15836fc3f11777c), [#8056](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8056)).
- **CLI:** Escape control characters in the media-use adopt skip line ([2749aafb3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2749aafb36336ad529d2f1fad5c90edb58de7128), [#8087](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8087)).
- **Core, Lint, Parsers:** Narrow the private-file rule for hidden files, build output and lint ([f5ccfcc96](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f5ccfcc96081943d1738173a4cf470c11da3c035), [#7990](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7990)).
- **Lint:** Derive the root duration with the parser's timing reader ([401991669](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/401991669d67c8a75f273b1921441cef9cfd2d85), [#8032](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8032)).
- **Lint:** Read a sub-composition mount's timing through the parser ([c84c30fd8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c84c30fd8d1cc0f124d6b64778c253f7d9d8f50d), [#8037](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8037)).
- **Core:** Drop motion-blur state on `__hfRuntimeTeardown` ([9797faea0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9797faea05944a260547d86a5a5b6a0ed89ad982), [#7996](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7996)).
- **CLI:** Keep a deleted received page listed in the received-files record ([e099c7d0c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e099c7d0cba21e9d89880590bea4c95259dc07ee), [#8090](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8090)).

## Docs & Examples

- **Docs:** Desktop exports on your computer are unlimited on every plan ([94cc7558e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/94cc7558e786289f221a05901c002dbf2102ab1d), [#8093](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8093)).

## Internal

- **GitHub:** Workflows, actions and publish scripts need a maintainer's review ([4f2eaaac4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4f2eaaac46458f5514e36d76683995fb5242af6f), [#8092](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8092)).

name: v0.9.63
body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.63

Released on 2026-11-17.

Studio's sealed preview shows audio meters and audio groups, a layer reorder is one undo step again, and text films start sooner. No HyperFrames server serves a project file as a service worker's script. This release also carries every change listed for 0.9.62. That version never reached npm: the merge queue landed it in one push with another PR, and the publish read only the push's last commit. Since #8077 a release publishes from its own commit in the push.

## Features

- **Core:** The preview can stream an element's geometry to the editor every frame ([f9c5ed07b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f9c5ed07bfc287b4097676b6c06e46b8f652e6c8), [#8052](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8052)).

## Performance

- **Engine:** Check still frames on several pages at once so text films start sooner ([8ec97da01](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8ec97da011f8746b6a82a03356ed3808aa7dfc6b), [#7997](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7997)).
- **Producer:** Frames start drawing while the audio mix finishes ([0be1a0719](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0be1a0719ca199119a2d719ef017f55cd274753f), [#7985](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7985)).

## Fixes

- **CLI, Producer, Inspector:** Render, capture and inspector servers never serve a service worker's script ([72925380c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/72925380cc98f1cad7b37310b8f5a75a5e071bc2), [#8073](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8073)).
- **Studio:** A layer reorder is one undo step again ([df31ce2b1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/df31ce2b15fd132432de6d39007ad345d5f5389e), [#8072](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8072)).
- **Studio:** Audio meters and audio groups work in a sealed preview ([93a4d29c0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/93a4d29c032bec4726372e9db4a1ffff96462fac), [#8011](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8011)).
- **Studio:** Adding a track no longer remounts every clip on the timeline ([b064e40e1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b064e40e13810a73ddf27c4e467fd8a5ba33400d), [#8068](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8068)).
- **Studio Server:** A project file is never served as a service worker's script ([b4acc1a1d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b4acc1a1da9b36e9e0e35e73e47697d6a59ed1ff), [#8064](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8064)).
- **Studio:** A service worker a project left behind is gone before a preview frame loads ([7a0bec682](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7a0bec682809f18ee37d5d4e085f73afaca6a9b1), [#8067](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8067)).
- **Core:** A held video picture is drawn through a VideoFrame closed after the draw ([43e5b7cec](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/43e5b7cecdd66d2df14cee219bb08db27da3d88f), [#7971](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7971)).
- **Producer:** Leave outside links out of site listings by default and warn SDK callers ([fbb483852](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fbb4838525313e4acb379963e7544fc621db781a), [#8065](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8065)).

## Internal

- **Publish:** A release merged in one push with other PRs publishes at its own commit ([9b565c8e0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9b565c8e025d0aae71a0ca061a21ef2edf893f8d), [#8077](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8077)).
- **Publish:** Publish to npm with the job's OIDC token, not a stored token ([c106793f7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c106793f79f155626e7fba7602b22a769b0af4ba), [#8070](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8070)).
- **Core:** The reloaded-video playhead test builds a smaller film so busy CI never times it out ([34f98e6a0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/34f98e6a04e572296e314485d8e2f330edb0ca69), [#8069](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8069)).
- **Studio:** The edit bench reads a sealed preview through its editing port ([5f8b7a6ee](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5f8b7a6eeee2241473b4d6fca7485301176987a6), [#8010](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8010)).
