name: v1.4.0-rc.3
body:
## beads v1.4.0-rc.3

Pre-compiled binaries for Linux, macOS (Intel & Apple Silicon), Windows (AMD64 & ARM64), Android/Termux (ARM64), and FreeBSD.

### Installation (release candidate)

> **This is a prerelease for validation.** The stable install channels —
> Homebrew, the `install.sh` / `install.ps1` scripts, npm, and PyPI —
> intentionally keep serving the latest **stable** release, so they will **not**
> install this RC. Use one of the methods below.

**Manual download (recommended):**
Download the archive for your platform from the **Assets** below, extract it,
and place `bd` on your PATH.

**Go install (pinned to this RC):**
```bash
go install github.com/steveyegge/beads/cmd/bd@v1.4.0-rc.3
# For embedded Dolt support:
CGO_ENABLED=1 GOFLAGS=-tags=gms_pure_go go install github.com/steveyegge/beads/cmd/bd@v1.4.0-rc.3
```

> **1.4.0 is a one-way upgrade. Back up first.** Consenting to the schema migration (`bd migrate schema`, `--force`, or `BD_ALLOW_MIGRATE=1`) moves a 1.2.x or 1.3.x store to schema v74. After that, bd 1.3.x and older refuse the database; going back means restoring a backup. From 1.4.0-rc.1 or rc.2, rc.3 is a binary swap: it adds no migration.
>
> - Validate on a copy, or on a store you have backed up with your current bd (`bd dolt push`, a JSONL export, or `bd backup sync`).
> - Every Dolt server bd talks to, and the `dolt` CLI on `PATH`, must be 2.6.0 or newer.
> - Read **Upgrade notes** and **Known issues** under `[1.4.0-rc.3]`, `[1.4.0-rc.2]` and `[1.4.0-rc.1]` in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/gastownhall/beads/blob/v1.4.0-rc.3/CHANGELOG.md) before installing.
>
> **New in rc.3:**
> - Telemetry no longer exports issue content. Correction to the rc.1 notes: with the console trace exporter on (`BD_OTEL_ENABLED=true` with `OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER=console`, or the legacy `BD_OTEL_STDOUT=true` on its own), rc.1 and rc.2 still wrote titles, descriptions, notes, labels, comments and search text to stderr in the `bd.args` span attribute ([#8505](https://github.com/gastownhall/beads/issues/8505)); logs that kept bd's stderr can hold it. `bd.args` now names only the command and the flags that were set, so trace queries that read its values must change.
> - bd ranks a release candidate below its release ([#6595](https://github.com/gastownhall/beads/issues/6595)), and in server and proxied-server workspaces moving from a candidate to 1.4.0 records the release in the version marker. From rc.3 on, server-mode `bd doctor` run in a terminal reports when 1.4.0 is out.
>
> **Behavior changes to know before installing** (from rc.2):
> - `bd github` now stops when a repository lookup fails. Rerun after a temporary failure. Never clear or repoint another repository's bead links to get past it: the next sync creates unlinked beads as new issues in the configured repository.
> - Server-mode pulls need EXECUTE on `dolt_fetch` and `dolt_merge`.
> - `bd backup restore` refuses a Dolt server on another host. Run it on the server's machine, in a workspace that names the same `dolt_database`.
>
> **Still open:**
> - [#7283](https://github.com/gastownhall/beads/issues/7283): in server mode, run bare `bd migrate` once per database if `bd doctor` reports a version mismatch after `bd migrate schema`.
> - Go programs that link beads cannot open a proxied-server workspace ([#8412](https://github.com/gastownhall/beads/pull/8412), [#8323](https://github.com/gastownhall/beads/issues/8323)).
> - `bd create --repo <url>`'s cached clone still writes the URL into merge commits ([#8434](https://github.com/gastownhall/beads/issues/8434)).
>
> When 1.4.0 ships, install it by hand. rc.3's server-mode `bd doctor`, run in a terminal, also tells you; nothing tells you on rc.1 or rc.2, on an embedded or proxied-server workspace, or when `bd doctor` runs under an agent, a script or `--json`.


## Changelog
### Bug Fixes
* b35d1bb7bf2d8632f9cda4b7532b7c1d55150892 fix(doctor): give CompareVersions semver-2.0 prerelease semantics (#6596)
* e16aa3f6f4079ab065292d66df4771dec6b2beb1 fix(telemetry): keep issue content out of bd.args (#8505) (#8508)
* 93aa92d010aafe5455dd6e7df64a9b9205d82d79 fix(version): a release records its version over its own release candidate (#8511)
### Others
* d42ff8dc678c050f9b1ffcd9adfe0b037d497e0d chore(release): prepare v1.4.0-rc.3

name: v0.22.11
body:
# oh-my-codex v0.22.11

## Summary

This patch release ships two fixes for setup reliability: preserving custom `developer_instructions` during legacy setup mode and canonicalizing `CODEX_HOME` for consistent symlink handling. These changes improve setup robustness when users have customized configurations or symlinked home directories.

## Fixed

- **PRESERVE CUSTOM DEVELOPER_INSTRUCTIONS DURING LEGACY SETUP (#4107):** Legacy setup mode now correctly preserves user-customized `developer_instructions` from existing configurations instead of overwriting them with default values. Fixes #4105.
- **CANONICALIZE CODEX_HOME FOR SYMLINK CONSISTENCY (#4108):** Doctor hook and setup logic now canonicalize `CODEX_HOME` paths to handle symlink aliases consistently. Symlinked home directories are now treated with uniform trust and identity across all setup and runtime operations. Fixes #4106.

## Dependencies

- @biomejs/biome: 2.6.6 → 2.6.7 (#4103, dev dependency)
- @napi-rs/lzma: 1.4.1 → 1.4.5 (#4104, runtime dependency)

## Compatibility

No breaking API changes. Release-coupled metadata (`package.json`, `package-lock.json`, Cargo workspace, and plugin metadata) all report `0.22.11`.

## Verification

- Full CI on dev candidate (candidate details recorded in [release readiness](docs/qa/release-readiness-0.22.11.md)).
- PR #4107 and #4108 CI passed on merged heads.

## Contributors

Thanks to [@dependabot[bot]](https://github.com/apps/dependabot), Watch, and [@Yeachan-Heo](https://github.com/Yeachan-Heo) for contributing to this release.

**Full Changelog**: [`v0.22.10...v0.22.11`](https://github.com/Yeachan-Heo/oh-my-codex/compare/v0.22.10...v0.22.11)

—
*[repo owner's gaebal-gajae (clawdbot) 🦞]*

**Highlights**

- GTX 900/1000-series NVIDIA cards run on the GPU again with a CUDA 12.6 PyTorch build (#4242)
- Close to tray: keep VoiceStudio and its jobs running when you close the window (#4174)
- Download buttons work in the Docker/web build (#4224)
- Faster-feeling starts: no more "first run" hint on every launch, and slow cold loads are no longer killed after 300 s (#4228)
- Security hardening across file actions, HTTP errors and CI, plus clearer Windows setup errors (#4173–#4188, #4213, #4230)

### Changed

- Opt-in automatic failure reports now name which part of the app failed (main process, GPU or helper process, GPU job timeout or network) instead of reporting an unknown error (#4243)
- Removed the unused retired desktop release cleanup helper and its ownership entry. (#4172) — thanks @salemalkadadi-debug!
- Removed an unused legacy update-busy helper while retaining active restart protection (#4149) — thanks @themrbeasley!
- Retired an unused legacy update toast while preserving the active Electron update controls (#4141) — thanks @themrbeasley!
- Retired the unreachable legacy shared UI and the guard tests that held it, repointing the live-behaviour guards to the renderer, and dropped 12 unused npm packages (#4095)
- Smaller install: removed unused leftover images and old helper code from the app source (#4087)
- Projects grid view stays smooth with thousands of items by drawing only the cards in view (#4079)
- Long Projects, dub project and Transcribe history lists now render only the rows on screen, so they stay fast with thousands of items (#4074)
- Idle CPU: a hidden or minimised window no longer runs polling timers or elapsed-time clocks, and they refresh once when it is shown again (#4073)
- Removed unused renderer files and 477 unused translation strings, and `locale:check` now fails on an English key no code uses (#4047)
- Removed more unused legacy shared components, utilities and API helpers from the old shared UI folder (#4045)
- Local-model folder saves no longer unload the engine when the stored folder did not change (#4043)
- Removed more unused legacy settings, gallery and engine screens from the old shared UI folder (#4042)
- Idle polling is relaxed: the backend health probe slows when steady, cloud-sync polling pauses while the window is hidden, and the Windows parent watcher polls less often (#4041)
- Removed more unused legacy dubbing screens and hooks from the old shared UI folder (#4040)
- Release notes now open with one Download table listing every desktop and phone download with its signing, followed by the Highlights (#4037)
- Removed about 25,000 lines of unused legacy interface code, two unused font packages and the always-skipped weekly evals job; the app itself is unchanged (#2603, #4032)

### Added

- Windows and Linux x64 PCs whose NVIDIA cards are all GTX 900/1000-series (compute capability 5.0 to 6.x, driver 525 or newer) now run on the GPU with a CUDA 12.6 PyTorch build, a one-time ~3 GB download on the next launch; voices, projects and models are kept (#4242)
- Settings → General can keep VoiceStudio and its running jobs alive in the tray when you close the window, instead of quitting (#4174)
- Stories can merge adjacent lines with the same speaker and compatible voice/speed settings while preserving text and inline directions — thanks [cvak on Discord](https://discord.com/channels/1497926884707799144/1497926886020354102/1566929293853073429)! (#4161)
- Added separately opted-in failure reporting through Supermetry app intake across desktop, mobile and server installs, with private metadata and consent-controlled retries (#4137)
- Dubbing exports the selected transcript as plain UTF-8 TXT, including edited text before generating a dub, with native Save As and paired phone sharing. (#4155) — thanks @shivamdhiman999111-source!
- A dub interrupted by a crash or restart now picks up from its finished segments instead of starting over (#4088)
- omnivoice-gguf now supports voice design, non-verbal tags and the decode-steps slider (#4084) — thanks @snazzybean!
- Cebuano is now a dub translation target (#4058, #4072) — thanks @onparr-24!
- Home shows a What's new link, winter pixel snow, a Christmas-week Santa, two rows of contributor portraits, and an easter egg that hides the credits until the next update after you visit three contributor profiles (#4070)
- Voice Cloning has a generation queue: takes started while one is rendering wait their turn and run one after another — thanks @ItzSudhan! (#4064)
- Audiobooks and Stories have a New project button that starts an empty draft without touching saved projects (#4055)

### Docs

- The localization contract no longer exempts the removed legacy shared i18n catalog, which pointed reviewers at a path that does not exist (#4186) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Document the enforced up-to-date merge gate while the repository cannot use GitHub merge queues (#4165)
- Track the unresolved VoxCPM2 installation report separately from GPU fallback fixes, reported by [vinhson](https://discord.com/users/1025270992882376704) (#4154)
- Track the unresolved Windows model-loading crash and distinguish merged installer repairs from released fixes (#4146) — thanks @renaldyramadani123-code!
- Installation tracking separates shipped fixes, pending repairs and unresolved report evidence (#4121)
- Document host-managed Tailscale access for Docker without sharing the host daemon socket (#4111) — thanks @MaverickKB!

### Fixed

- Windows setup now explains a torch c10.dll "WinError 1114" load failure, naming an outdated Visual C++ runtime when that is the cause and listing what to try otherwise (#4230)
- Trimmed speech now ends with a short fade-out instead of a sharp cut-off (#4229)
- The startup screen only says "first run can take several minutes" while the Python environment is actually being installed, and the OmniVoice engine now reports progress during cold imports, reference transcription and synthesis so slow starts are no longer killed as "sent nothing for 300s" (#4228)
- Windows ROCm setup prefers the AMD driver's newer HIP runtime, fixing an `amdhip64_7.dll` crash on dGPU + Ryzen iGPU systems, with automatic fallback to the bundled runtime (#4225) — thanks @giuseppefaro!
- Download buttons for generated audio, batch and audiobook exports now work in the Docker/web build (#4222, #4224) — thanks @msy-jc!
- Windows startup errors distinguish Smart App Control evaluation mode from an active policy block (#4213) — thanks @isnaenihidayat!
- Safari extension errors with WebKit top-level stack frames no longer open the repair and bug-report prompt (#4211) — thanks @karlnorling!
- Dubbing keeps API requests responsive while marking fresh speech on the watermark worker; recovered speech retains its existing mark (#4198) — thanks @swax!
- Stories and Audiobook keep saved audio with its original connection and offer an explicit availability check for older results (#4196)
- The changelog reference allowlist no longer outlives the entries it exempts: two dead exemptions were removed and a guard now reports any future ones (#4188) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- HTTP error messages no longer interpolate raw exception text: filesystem and parsing failures return fixed, actionable text, and the remaining details pass through core.scrub.scrub_text to redact secrets and home paths (#4183) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Release preparation no longer aborts when the contributors block cannot be assembled, and a missing previous release only skips that block (#4181) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- The commit identity check now resolves to a definite status when a pull request moves mid-run, instead of leaving a required check pending forever (#4180) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- The gallery pin check now validates a pull request with the checker from its base commit, so a PR cannot move the pin and weaken the check in one commit (#4179) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Bundled installs that cannot run database migrations now enforce one cloud-sync identity per voice, so a duplicate identity is caught locally instead of surfacing later as a sync conflict (#4176) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Phone model catalogues generate on Windows again: the hash-pinned and byte-compared contract artifacts keep LF endings in every checkout (#4175) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Restrict native file-opening actions to the primary app window while preserving trusted recorder exports and window-local controls (#4173) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Community Gallery limits mounted cards in large catalogues while retaining the current preview, keyboard focus and paging (#4169)
- Desktop failure observers retain the original consent during backend restarts and preserve normal Promise behavior. (#4209)
- CosyVoice catalogue downloads skip unused alternative model files and use the same required assets as managed installs. (#4207)
- Android keeps large manuscripts editable and recoverable, and retains reporting consent through permission prompts. (#4206) — thanks @gaino-svg!
- The closed-PR CI sweep requests cancellations incrementally, preserves partial progress and reports incomplete searches or skipped requests accurately (#4189) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Kept automatic error reports bound to original consent through delayed work and recovery, and preserved native CI verification (#4184) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Windows ROCm setup preserves working-install stamps, verifies the pinned interpreter, and reports native crash exit codes (#4182) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Windows checkouts no longer fail the CLI packaging tests: the Debian maintainer-script cases skip when the host has no POSIX shell or symlink privileges (#4178) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Phone dubbing clip/stem exports check output space on both platforms and avoid false low-space errors on iOS (#4168)
- Linux ROCm setup skips CUDA downloads and preserves its installed PyTorch stack on resume (#4167) — thanks @khryztiam!
- GPU readiness and in-process routing reflect completed self-test failures (#4166) — thanks @khryztiam!
- CLA audits keep exempt accounts visible for provenance review without reporting a missing required signature (#4164)
- Release rehearsals show measured Android APK signing, and tagged downloads require matching signature evidence (#4163)
- Manual Windows crash reports retain the faulting thread ahead of verbose status tails — thanks @renaldyramadani123-code and @freemood36-svg! (#4162)
- macOS publishing checks Gatekeeper even when Windows installers are explicitly unsigned (#4153)
- The reviewed model-install steps now require the same authenticated consumer as the rest of the model manager (#4152) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Diagnostic bundles and Electron bug reports redact share PINs and encoded credential query parameters (#4151) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Make the installed-model licence action open its terms and acknowledgement dialog — thanks [hugotriunfa18 on Discord](https://discord.com/users/1571221621316784260)! (#4147)
- Android model downloads resume through VPNs while preserving Wi-Fi policy and saved ranges (#4140) — thanks @JerryTimi!
- Stopped playback errors from incorrectly claiming that generated audio files are missing (#4138) — thanks @AAYUSH-CODER1904!
- Transcriptions can save clean plain text and timed SRT captions, with an explanation when subtitle timings are unavailable (#4135)
- Cloud sign-in now rejects a discovery document whose token or revocation endpoint is not on the issuer's own origin (#4133) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Segmented model downloads pin public destinations with bounded DNS checks across redirects, ranges and proxies, preventing private-network fallback and CDN credential leaks (#4132) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- The LM Studio model probe no longer sends the stored API key in clear text to a remote host unless plaintext LAN is allowed (#4131) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- A deterministic test now fails when a new mutating API route ships without an authorization decision (#4130) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Docker deployments now require the administrator API key for the runtime log, log stream, recent errors and crash report, as the install docs already said (#4129) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- MCP tools preserve remote caller permissions across local and HTTP backends, including failed transport lookups (#4128) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- TTS and event WebSockets now enforce the same loopback/credential rule as dictation, closing a share-PIN bypass (#4126) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Imported project bundles can no longer make ffmpeg fetch remote URLs through a playlist-shaped media file (#4125) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Deleting history, rewriting dub scripts and clearing model-licence receipts now require an administrator, as the API docs already promised (#4124) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- SoniTranslate installation and start/stop now require a local administrator, like every other engine installer (#4123) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Model deletion over the API now requires administrator rights (#4122) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Crash recurrence reports recognize current Electron version fields and distinguish beta releases (#4120)
- Reclaim idle GPU models before generation when VRAM or RAM is low (#4117) — thanks @vandyahmad24!
- Model downloads reject damaged files and retry without reusing corrupt ranges, while cancellation preserves verified work (#4116)
- Reuse verified setup wheels on low-space retries and handle interrupted size probes without an uncaught error. (#4115)
- Saved and inline pronunciation choices apply consistently across speech, dubbing, batch and voice-conversion routes (#4114) — thanks @nntloc!
- Stop cancelled setup retries promptly and keep verbose runtime probes from blocking on their diagnostic output. (#4113)
- Long recordings use duration-scaled transcription limits across uploads, dubbing, child engines and MCP tools (#4112) — thanks @xabiherdz-svg!
- URL imports restore their connection guard after temporary DNS resolver changes (#4110)
- Update the optional Dagger pipeline's OpenTelemetry dependencies to fix excessive CPU use when parsing malformed trace context. (#4109)
- Optional analytics no longer delays backend readiness, and consent changes invalidate queued startup work (#4108) — thanks @cf3901646!
- Auto setup can retry PyPI failures through the regional mirror and report the actual failed host (#4107) — thanks @mrkeshi!
- Malformed model-install status responses keep the interface open and preserve the last valid download state (#4106) — thanks @ftlcustomerservice73-ui!
- Windows installer process checks skip custom PowerShell profiles, and source installs use shorter build paths to avoid MSVC linker failures (#4099)
- Restarting to install an update keeps update status available while the local engine shuts down, avoiding missing-handler errors (#4098)
- Automatic blank-renderer recovery keeps the open workspace instead of returning Stories or Audiobook to Home (#4097)
- Dubbing keeps the saved recording for cloned and designed voices with style instructions, so each segment uses the selected speaker's reference (#4093)
- Setup on Auto-detect now retries a stalled Python download (`cpython-… (download)`) once from the other source, GitHub or its mirror, instead of stalling again (#4085)
- A refused cross-site API request now names its origin and gives the exact `OMNIVOICE_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` line to add, so other local apps such as AIRI can be connected (#4083)
- Setup no longer crashes with "Cannot set property code" when a runtime download or check is cancelled on Windows (#4082)
- MOSS-TTS-Nano speaks again on a fresh one-click install: the transformers 5 shim no longer breaks model loads in its pinned transformers 4 environment (#4063, #4078) — thanks @RerankerGuo, and @rockziepromax for the report!
- OmniVoice GGUF falls back to the CPU when the GPU backend crashes, for example Vulkan on a GTX 1080 (#4050, #4072) — thanks @MeinLive!
- Full dubs no longer fail when translation fills segments with free-text directions like "slow"; unsupported ones are dropped for that segment (#4054, #4072) — thanks @user555gtb!
- Audiobook MP3 exports play and download again instead of returning 404 (#4071, #4072) — thanks @dimfk001git!
- Colab: setup cells show the failing command's output, the security-floor check judges the Mako copy Python imports, and the web UI loads through the new `*.prod.r.colab.dev` proxy — thanks @hkarmoush! (#4069)
- Turning on LAN sharing no longer crashes the backend with an Internal Server Error — thanks @blutuxyz! (#4059)
- The OmniVoice GGUF engine finds its bundled runtime again in installed apps instead of reporting it missing — thanks @b84330808! (#4053)
- When the operating system times out starting the engine (`spawn ETIMEDOUT`, seen on macOS), VoiceStudio retries twice and then says to restart the computer (#4039)
- Settings → Updates lists only your channel's releases, and Beta suggests switching to Stable when a newer stable is out (#4038)
- SSML `[spell]` keeps flag, ZWJ-joined and skin-tone emoji whole instead of splitting them (#4020) — thanks @kevin9327!

### CI

- CI actions gain artifact and no-push Docker contract checks, with one bounded mobile artifact-upload retry (#4192)
- CI pins the version of the security analyser it installs at run time, so a new release cannot silently change the findings (#4187) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Documentation and inventory changes run a read-only docs drift check on relevant pull requests, with rolling-issue maintenance kept in nightly/manual jobs (#4185) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Container builds grant the registry-write token only to the jobs that publish images, not to every job in the workflow (#4177) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- CI reuses unchanged iOS checks, rechecks shared diagnostic inputs and skips Nix builds for documentation and test changes. (#4208)
- Windows release and optional-engine tests use portable text fixtures, native Bash and normalized cache paths (#4197) — thanks @swax!
- Release builds load app-intake credentials from GitHub Actions Secrets without public-variable fallbacks (#4204, #4205)
- Fixed Android screenshot capture waiting behind the optional error-report prompt (#4202) — thanks @velixio!
- Keep iOS voice-search and download checks reliable across saved model choices (#4171)
- The iPhone smoke test waits for typed text to reach the editor instead of reading it once, removing a CI flake (#4100)
- MOSS compatibility tests keep checking the active Transformers version after another test restores imported modules (#4096)
- The iPhone UI smoke test keeps its slow-inventory case loading for the whole test, so a slow simulator no longer fails it (#4076)
- Docker's web build no longer fails the unused-key check when only `electron/` is copied, and the iPhone CI job allows for a native-runtime cache miss (#4052)
- Removed unused scripts, the old Tauri MSI tooling and leftover Turborepo ignore lines (#4046)
- Accessibility smoke timeouts now name the requests still pending, so a flaky CI failure points at its cause (#4036)

### Bug reporters

- @gaino-svg — long Android manuscripts (#4201)
- @renaldyramadani123-code and @freemood36-svg — native-crash evidence that improved manual reports; the underlying Windows crash remains unresolved (#4142, #4158, #4162)
- @rockziepromax — MOSS-TTS-Nano voice cloning (#4063)
- @MeinLive — GGUF GPU crashes and the relocated runtime lookup (#4050, #4051)
- @user555gtb — directions that interrupted full dubs (#4054)
- @dimfk001git — audiobook MP3 playback and downloads (#4071)
- [hugotriunfa18 on Discord](https://discord.com/channels/1497926884707799144/1571229026138325102/1571229026138325102) — the installed-model licence action (#4143)
- [vinhson on Discord](https://discord.com/channels/1497926884707799144/1567177140007608350/1567177140007608350) — VoxCPM2 installation evidence retained in the tracker; this report remains unresolved (#4154)

name: Voyager v2.3.3
body:
> _"Adventure is out there!" — 《Up》 (2009)_ ## ✨ What's New | Feature | Description | | --- | --- | | **Grok support** | 12 plugins now work on grok.com, including the timeline, export, formula copy and the prompt manager. They start off; turn on the ones you want under Plugins. (PR #1098, #1099, #1101) | | **New chat in a folder** | Right-click a folder and pick **New chat in this folder**; the chat files itself there after the first message. | | **Folder chip on the composer** | A small tag above the input box shows which folder a new chat will go to, and lets you switch or clear it. | | **Formulas survive copying** | Copying part of an answer turns its formulas into LaTeX, ready for notes or documents. | | **Text-only export** | **Text only** in Markdown export gives a single .md file without images. | | **Subfolders first** | An open folder lists its subfolders above its chats; the old order is one switch away in folder settings. | ## 🐛 Bug Fixes | Fix | Description | | --- | --- | | **Folder rename** | Enter no longer saves a half-typed IME name, and finishes a rename on Firefox again. | | **Cloud sync** | Uploading no longer fails on ChatGPT or Claude before any folders exist there. | | **Gemini watermark removal** | The star comes off dark or textured images too. | | **Gemini timeline** | Image-only prompts show up on the timeline. | | **Other** | Popup tabs scroll sideways, quoting several paragraphs adds no blank lines, the floating ball's buttons are easier to click, and the What's New title names Voyager. | _All changes by @Nagi-ovo unless noted._ --- ## 中文版 > _「去冒险吧！」——《飞屋环游记》（2009）_ ## ✨ 新功能 | 功能 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | **支持 Grok** | 时间线、导出、公式复制、提示词管理器等 12 个插件能在 grok.com 上用了。默认关闭，在插件里打开想用的就行。（PR #1098、#1099、#1101） | | **在文件夹里开新对话** | 右键文件夹，选「在此文件夹新建对话」，发出第一条消息后自动归进去。 | | **输入框上的文件夹标签** | 新对话会去哪个文件夹，输入框上方一眼能看到，也能换或取消。 | | **复制时公式不再丢** | 复制一段回答，里面的公式变成 LaTeX，粘到笔记或文档里照样能用。 | | **只导出文字** | 导出 Markdown 时打开「仅文本」，得到一个不带图片的 .md 文件。 | | **子文件夹排在前面** | 打开文件夹时子文件夹列在对话上方；想换回原顺序，在文件夹设置里改。 | ## 🐛 问题修复 | 修复 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | **文件夹改名** | 输入法打字时按回车不会提交没打完的名字；Firefox 上按回车也能完成改名了。 | | **云同步** | 在 ChatGPT 或 Claude 上还没建过文件夹时，上传不再报错。 | | **Gemini 去水印** | 背景偏暗或有纹理的图片也能去掉星标。 | | **Gemini 时间线** | 只发了图片的提问也会出现在时间线上。 | | **其他** | 弹窗顶部栏目能左右翻，引用多段不再多空行，悬浮球旁的按钮更好点，更新说明标题写明是 Voyager。 | _除特别注明外，均由 @Nagi-ovo 提交。_ --- **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/voyager-crew/voyager/compare/v2.3.2...v2.3.3 ## 📥 Installation
     

Edge users: Voyager is still maintained on Edge Add-ons for users who need Edge on mobile or tablet. If review is delayed, Chrome Web Store and GitHub manual packages remain available.

- **Chrome / Edge / Chromium browsers**: `voyager-chrome-v2.3.3.zip` - **Firefox**: `voyager-firefox-v2.3.3.xpi` - **Safari**: `voyager-v2.3.3.dmg` > Do not use GitHub's auto-generated **Source code (zip/tar.gz)** archives for manual extension installs. Those files are repository source snapshots, not browser-ready extension packages.
🍎 Safari 安装与升级说明 (Safari installation & upgrade) > 🎉 从 v1.6.0 起，Voyager 的核心功能已正式覆盖 Safari。 > Starting with v1.6.0, Voyager's core experience is officially supported on Safari. - 📦 **安装 (Installation)**: 下载并打开 `voyager-v2.3.3.dmg`，按提示安装应用。 Download and open `voyager-v2.3.3.dmg`, then follow the prompts to install the app. - ⚠️ **旧版升级 (Legacy upgrade)**: 如果仍安装着 `Gemini Voyager.app`，请先完成一次 [Safari 迁移步骤](https://voyager.nagi.fun/guide/safari-migration)，避免两个 App 并存。 If `Gemini Voyager.app` is still installed, follow the one-time [Safari migration guide](https://voyager.nagi.fun/en/guide/safari-migration) first so the two apps do not conflict. - 🖼️ **图片能力 (Images)**: Image Refinement 水印去除、全尺寸图片下载与聊天导出中的图片提取均已支持。 Image Refinement watermark removal, full-size image downloads, and image extraction in conversation exports are supported. - ☁️ **原生云同步 (Native cloud sync)**: Google Drive 与 iCloud 同步均已接入 Safari 原生层。 Google Drive and iCloud sync are integrated through Safari's native layer. - 🔔 **系统通知 (Notifications)**: Gemini 回复完成后可发送 macOS 通知，并直达对应对话。 macOS can notify you when a Gemini response finishes and open the matching conversation. - 🔄 **自动更新 (Automatic updates)**: 完成这次迁移后，后续版本可通过 Sparkle 自动更新。 After this one-time migration, future versions can update automatically through Sparkle.

name: openclaw 2026.10.33
body:
This is a gateway-only `extended-stable` release, which is our current equivalent to LTS. This release is OpenClaw from the end of October 2026, plus critical security updates, reliability and performance fixes, and features like new model support. The latest version of OpenClaw at the time of this release is [2026.11.5](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/releases#release-v2026.11.5)

## 2026.10.33

This extended-stable release brings cumulative Gateway and core-plugin improvements since 2026.9.37, plus the selected maintenance fixes on the approved 2026.11.4 product baseline. Distribution covers the core npm package, matching official npm plugins, and Gateway Docker images; native-app releases are not included.

### Highlights

- Long conversations and large session stores use bounded export and recovery work, reducing out-of-memory failures during chat, memory export, Doctor repair, and Gateway startup. (#194066, #196158, #195459, #196480, #176737, #181289) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @ericcaiwx-star, @obviyus, @garrytan, and @oxen-horse.
- Interrupted updates recover when their executor dies instead of leaving the Gateway stuck offline, while version-skew checks protect state still used by an installed service. (#181695, #186971, #187819) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @PonySlayer28, @tomdailey55, @jalehman, @fuller-stack-dev, and @vincentkoc.
- Replies survive more restart and reconnect paths, preserving original prompts, recovering Telegram responses, and avoiding lost WhatsApp replies or skipped Signal messages. (#187157, #195400, #168778, #187667) Thanks @shakkernerd, @jason-allen-oneal, @mcaxtr, @HermanZeng, and @obviyus.
- Shared-session privacy is stronger: Side chat stays private to its viewer, internal model prompts stay out of displayed output, and compaction redacts credentials in quoted summaries. (#185390, #173460, #197349) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @Satoshi-Kusumoto, @RomneyDa, @zhangguiping-xydt, @Patrick-Erichsen, and @obviyus.
- Automations can react to polled conditions and MCP events, run repeatable scripts, and use explicitly allowed MCP servers. (#101195, #165399, #160996, #160995) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @obviyus.
- Installed skills can be searched and read on demand, helping agents find relevant instructions without putting every installed skill into the prompt. (#158089, #158090, #158091, #160538) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.
- Sessions can import existing Claude Code or Codex transcripts and move between local and cloud environments, with repository recipes and clearer cloud-startup progress. (#161955, #171690, #170862, #170895) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @joshavant and @RomneyDa.

### Additional maintenance fixes

- Provider continuity: preserve server compaction checkpoints across credential or model changes on the same provider API and endpoint, avoiding unnecessary history replay. (#200063, #200208) Thanks @obviyus.
- macOS installation: preserve the controlling terminal during shell installation so onboarding can install plugins without detached Node subprocesses aborting. (#200247) Thanks @miguelbranco80.
- Update recovery: record successful Gateway startup writes for the next Doctor run without accepting changes that predate startup. (#200260) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Existing device folders: recognize models using the implicit OpenClaw runtime without turning that default into an explicit session override. (#190065) Thanks @obviyus.
- Plugin compatibility: retain the signed 2026.11.4 source baseline as this release's compatibility identity without changing its displayed version or lowering plugin API requirements. (#200302) Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Changes

- Session organization: snooze conversations, choose a custom wake time, and explicitly organize or archive nested conversations. (#161960, #171255, #168076) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @jacobtomlinson.
- Session context: show task progress in Details, indicate when a chat is waiting on helpers, and open the Subagents panel from the chat's helper count. (#161674, #164190, #166142) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @ceckert, @obviyus, @vyctorbrzezowski, and @shakkernerd.
- Shared conversations: add emoji reactions to prompts and replies and configure when sessions may send or receive messages. (#161053, #162316) Authored by @steipete.
- Workspace placement: start sessions in existing folders on paired devices or select hosted workspaces when creating sessions. (#169722, #168259) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @obviyus.
- First-run setup: automatically choose inference and offer optional memory-embedding setup, including non-interactive embedding-only local setup. (#169628, #163693, #170153) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @PollyBot13 and @dh-js.
- Memory providers: use a provider-neutral memory runtime with host-resolved audiences and provider-owned pre-compaction flushes. (#162175, #162176, #162177) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @jalehman.
- Context management: use provider-native compaction on supported OpenAI and Anthropic API-key routes, server-side compaction for ChatGPT sign-in sessions, and model fallback after context-overflow recovery. (#168164, #168401, #170141) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @joshavant, @RomneyDa, @ceckert, @obviyus, @goslingmanagment, @dmsrg399, @aniketkrs, and @amirarenco-create.
- Model setup: support endpoint-resolved custom aliases, show provider recommendations first, and display active authentication subscription blocks. (#170009, #167370, #133087) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @ceckert, @obviyus, @xyrolle, @Leon-SK668, and @vincentkoc.
- Provider integrations: add Particle and Muse Code runtime support, including Muse sign-in through Model Setup. (#187135, #170487, #171526) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @obviyus.
- Voice calls: add per-call briefs, reports, live steering, callbacks, and voicemail detection; OpenAI realtime voice can use a custom endpoint. (#165716, #165632) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @jacobtomlinson and @mbelinky.
- Microsoft Teams: support multiple bot accounts. (#112811) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @jimmypuckett.
- X integration: add mentions, GitHub-verified repository writers, guest repository questions, and daily/monthly API cost limits. (#165138, #168071, #165354, #165351) Authored by @steipete.
- MCP apps: use apps across conversations and workspace files, keep an app's tool access while its view is open, and connect through a principal-bound relay. (#161747, #164496, #168233) Authored by @steipete.
- Plugin interfaces: let plugins dock conversations, open session panels, and supply Solid-based Control UI views. (#161957, #163428, #168408) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @jalehman.
- Plugin-assisted conversations: fork live context for background side questions and steer an active session through supported plugin operations. (#170146, #170152) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @ceckert, and @obviyus.
- Code Mode: retain store/load values across cells, replies, and restarts, and return wrapped browser observations for programmatic use. (#164086, #164833) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @alkor2000, and @potterdigital.
- Backups: support external-disk and Cloudflare R2 destinations and preserve PostgreSQL-backed stores through backups and updates. (#161913, #170828) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @joshavant and @RomneyDa.
- Database administration: add verified offline database-port operations with interrupted-port protection and replacement verification. (#170518, #171265, #171368) Authored by @steipete.
- Cloud environments: group environments by repository, save suggested profiles on first use, and provision verified Node toolchains. (#170892, #170875, #170796) Authored by @steipete.
- Control UI: customize branding and session backgrounds, play YouTube videos inline, fold code in diffs, and use terminal fonts with Nerd Font icons. (#168027, #168301, #164576, #172350, #166180) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski and @jacobtomlinson.
- Navigation and language: use a compact personal sidebar rail, return to Discord or Slack from session headers, and use Swedish localization. (#168325, #158742, #62063) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @VACInc, @Patrick-Erichsen, @yeager, and @vincentkoc.
- Installation: offer an opt-in pinned Bun runtime and standalone executables. (#168832, #172384) Authored by @steipete.

### Fixes

- Update recovery: reclaim offline maintenance after a dead update executor so the Gateway can start again without manual database repair. (#181695) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @PonySlayer28.
- Update compatibility: avoid premature state migrations, keep unrelated or older installed services from blocking valid configuration and Doctor operations, and retain plugin lifecycle ownership during lengthy finalization. (#186971, #187870, #187886, #187966, #190194, #196474, #188404) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @tomdailey55, @shakkernerd, and @Satoshi-Kusumoto.
- Installation diagnostics: fail clearly when Homebrew bootstrap fails, handle shell characters in private CLI install paths, start Windows setup after npm-shim installation, and use a private workspace when the system temporary directory is unsafe. (#187688, #189541, #185309, #187737) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @McgAtom, @obviyus, @DonnieFi, and @Yachiyo1680.
- Large histories: bound transcript trimming, indexing, memory export, and Doctor repair to avoid exhausting worker or Gateway memory. (#194066, #196158, #195459, #196480) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @ericcaiwx-star, @obviyus, and @garrytan.
- Startup responsiveness: narrow session recovery reads and avoid delaying plugin startup on large session stores. (#176737, #181289) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @oxen-horse.
- Persistent state: preserve PostgreSQL commit durability, settle staged authority at physical commit, and recover chats after database connection loss. (#180821, #193842, #181661) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @joshavant, @RomneyDa, and @vincentkoc.
- Files: reject stale saves after the workspace has been replaced instead of writing into the wrong workspace state. (#178336) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @shakkernerd.
- Shared-session privacy: keep another viewer's Side chat and private model prompt projections out of displayed content. (#185390, #173460) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen and @obviyus.
- Secrets: redact credentials in quoted compaction output and keep Skills-page key saves from replacing SecretRefs with plaintext. (#197349, #197319) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @obviyus and @mmaps.
- Configuration safety: reject reserved assignment keys, preserve restrictive allowlists after filtering, keep disabled mixed-case plugins disabled, and avoid catalog imports beside stored SecretRefs. (#191389, #190068, #188846, #179802) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @obviyus, @vincentkoc, @wangmiao0668000666, @yetval, @masatohoshino, and @ensignwesley.
- Tool authority: require effective approval for delegated changes, check prepared images through input-policy hooks, and reject late or ambiguous capability-scoped attachment requests. (#196984, #196337, #159106, #190863) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @joshavant, @montrellcruse, @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @sallyom, and @arpe1618.
- Sandbox upgrades: protect writable ancestors of nested skill mounts, prepare protected mount sources at first launch, and resume turns after mount additions. (#180840, #182412, #182789) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @eleqtrizit, @momothemage, and @akang1798.
- Repository and ingestion boundaries: restrict limited roles to public repositories and reject special files during memory-wiki ingestion. (#194830, #187621) Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski, @Leon-SK668, and @obviyus.
- Restart delivery: preserve original prompts, recover Telegram final replies, and keep WhatsApp responses and Signal inbound messages across reloads or reconnects. (#187157, #195400, #168778, #187667) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @shakkernerd, @jason-allen-oneal, @mcaxtr, @HermanZeng, and @obviyus.
- Telegram and IRC: deliver agent inline-button taps before expiry and honor explicitly empty IRC channel sender lists. (#196217, #196293) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @goslingmanagment, @dmsrg399, @obviyus, @kkernan, and @mmaps.
- Streaming responsiveness: prevent long non-streaming Slack reasoning and deeply nested progress-label paths from freezing the Gateway. (#196250, #196282) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @ptu-gh, @obviyus, and @LeizhenZhang.
- Automation completion: retain session-targeted cron and system-event replies, prepare completion permissions before loading requester state, and release suspended helper completions correctly. (#196750, #197434, #197323) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @jlapenna, @RomneyDa, @1052326311, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @holgergruenhagen, and @wr-web.
- Code Mode execution: settle failed calls, bound silent streams, retain process results at suspended-run capacity, and stop cleanly after reply-decoding memory exhaustion. (#196435, #196927, #188023) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.
- Claude sessions: avoid startup deadlocks and first-turn failures following cancelled login checks during token refresh. (#173011, #197032) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @ericcaiwx-star, @sopa-gpters, @obviyus, and @kir1ll.
- Provider recovery: retain quota recovery across concurrent sessions, accept retained Z.AI Coding Plan models, remove invalid Gemini schema enums, and bound silent native-session startup. (#176602, #195390, #196742, #196517) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @montrellcruse, @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @jason-allen-oneal, @obviyus, and @yixiaoer-520.
- Conversation continuity: keep active turns running across automatic rollover, preserve canonical reconstructed context, and release memory after non-announcing helpers finish. (#197345, #194362, #196672) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @ceckert, @obviyus, @gloss-dandelion-cult, @sunlit-deng, @maxdjohnson, @vincentkoc, @Jo2234, @abacha, @rabsef-bicrym, and @jalehman.
- Plugin lifecycle: avoid holding the state writer during initial admission, prevent configuration-only restarts from hanging reloads, and keep official plugin selectors on the stable channel. (#182117, #182331, #194812) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @DonnieFi.
- Cloud preparation: bootstrap private QA builds correctly and avoid falsely reporting unsaved work during fresh guest PR preparation. (#181824, #185777) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @shakkernerd.
- Doctor and recovery: support startup with conflicting legacy exec approvals, avoid read-only database copies on full disks, reject incomplete database-port success, and skip missing sanitized config companions when nothing remains to import. (#196401, #196346, #194595, #186998) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @fuller-stack-dev, @ylcn91, @reisball, and @AlyaKoni.
- Workspace readiness: do not mistake sandbox-written files for Gateway readiness, and preserve command outcomes when shutdown fails. (#197248, #188891) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, and @mmaps.
- Session navigation: keep touch links clear of row actions and prevent Doctor repairs from renaming the main session to an internal heartbeat marker. (#194840, #179219) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @VACInc, @Satoshi-Kusumoto, @RomneyDa, @najef1979-code, and @vyctorbrzezowski.
- Rescue commands: retain useful diagnostic findings when a command exits nonzero instead of losing the response. (#195451) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @wr-web and @mdarapour.

### Complete contribution record

The full contribution record is available in the tag-pinned [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.10.33/CHANGELOG/records/2026.10.33.md#complete-contribution-record).

name: v5.1.77
body:
**On Windows, a busy sign-in lock now names the process holding it.** `omo login`, `whoami` and `logout` used to report the holder as exited or unreadable whenever it was still running, so the message gave no pid and no fix. They now name its pid and image (read with `tasklist`), the lock path, and `taskkill /PID <pid> /F` as the way to end it. ([#14118](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14118), refs #14001)

### Changed

- GPT lanes (`ultrabrain`, `deep-high`, `deep-low`, `unspecified-low`), the plan reviewer and both Obsessive profiles lead with GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol. GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol stay right behind at the same effort, so an engine or provider without 6.2 (including GitHub Copilot) keeps the models it ran before. GPT-6.2 ids get the low..max effort ladder, and `none` and `minimal` are sent as `low`. (#14126) ([#14149](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14149))
- OmO now runs on senpi 2026.11.18 (from 2026.11.15-4), the release that carries the GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol catalog rows and the `gpt-6.2` prompt preset. (#14126) ([#14149](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14149))
- **Thread tool rows in the TUI now read like a status line instead of a JSON dump.** Each `thread_*` tool shows one call line (the verb, the target thread's name or short id, and the message's first line) and one outcome line with a few short details: `-> planner  follow-up delivered (turn 306)`, `planner: 12 messages (latest: ...)`, `3 threads in this workspace` with the first few threads, `created scratch`. Delivery ids, message sequence numbers and full uuids stay out of the collapsed row; a failure shows its code, message and next step; the expanded view (ctrl+o) adds the full result. What the model receives is unchanged. ([#12997](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12997)) ([#14141](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14141))

### Fixed

- A `thread_send` to a busy thread on another device that was queued there as a follow-up now answers `queued` with its `delivery_id` and `effective_mode`. It used to answer `idempotency_uncertain` ("accepted the message but did not report where it waits") even though the message was delivered and answered. The receiving engine's `queued` admission is its receipt, and its pending-message count does not include admitted deliveries. ([#14013](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14013), fixes [#14012](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/14012)) ([#14141](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14141))
- A reply to a peer on another device no longer answers `not_found` when the delivery that brought the peer's message carries no device attestation (an `rpc:local/<id>` or bare delivery id). If this device holds no session by that id or stated name, the reply is looked up account-wide. It is delivered only to the session the sender's durable id names; another match is `reply_target_mismatch`, and an id that more than one device lists is `ambiguous_target` with nothing sent. ([#14052](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14052)) ([#14141](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14141))
- `thread_create` with a `prompt` gives the new thread that prompt as its own first user message, with the creator's authority, instead of a relayed peer message under the gateway header. A later `thread_send` from any session, the creator included, keeps the relay header. ([#14058](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14058)) ([#14141](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14141))
- `omo -p` exits again after the run calls a thread tool. The device-service connection a thread tool opened is now closed when the session shuts down, so it no longer keeps a finished print-mode run alive. ([#14062](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14062)) ([#14141](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14141))
- The thread tools' descriptions now name each tool both directly and in its eval form (for example "thread_list (tool.thread_list() in an eval cell)"), so they read correctly in a session that has no eval tool, where the thread tools are ordinary direct tools. ([#14070](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14070)) ([#14141](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14141))
- `thread_list` no longer reports the sessions of a device that is offline or did not answer as live. Their rows come from the relay's cached snapshot and are now listed `resumable`; opening one with `thread_create` asks that device to reopen it, and answers `device_offline` while the device stays offline. A listed thread with an empty title shows its folder's name instead of an empty name; that label is for display only and is not an address. ([#14084](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14084)) ([#14141](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14141))
- `thread_read` and the thread control tools no longer answer `not_found` for a session that another device of the account holds but runs nowhere, when it is addressed by session id. `thread_read`, `thread_interrupt`, `thread_rename`, `thread_set_model` and `thread_set_reasoning` answer `not_resumable`, and `thread_close` answers `closed: false` with reason `not_live`, as on the device that holds it. A name still answers `not_found` there, and `thread_read` does not read that device's transcript. ([#14087](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14087)) ([#14141](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14141))
- After a sign-in refresh, short commands such as `omo account whoami` no longer stay running for up to 30 seconds while omo binds the device to this computer: that step now stops within its 5-second budget, and once the budget runs out it changes nothing and prints nothing. ([#14090](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14090))
- A thread tool call that stays on this device no longer asks for its own approval inside an eval cell you already approved. Listing, reading, creating, renaming, closing or messaging a local thread from one cell now asks once (for the cell) instead of once per call. A call that may change another device still asks. Local thread tools work the same signed out as signed in. ([#14082](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14082))
- `thread_create` on this device no longer leaves a prompt-less thread when the connection closes after the host made the session. The create finds the thread it made and answers it, and a retry under the same `idempotency_key` answers the same thread and admits the prompt exactly once. A retry that cannot find that thread here (a create on another device, or a host that ignored the derived id) still answers `idempotency_uncertain`. ([#14066](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14066))
- On Linux, a locked Secret Service that unlocks without a prompt (for example a headless gnome-keyring with an empty-password login collection) no longer blocks the OmO sign-in: omo asks it to unlock first and reports it locked only when unlocking needs a password or prompt. ([#14040](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14040))
- Cold wake: the OmO session host service no longer restarts itself every 30 seconds on Linux and macOS. It starts the host once at login, on every `omo remote bootstrap`, and again whenever another device wakes a session here; a start that hangs ends after 5 minutes. `omo remote status` shows it running while its host is up, and unknown when the host cannot be read (#13668). ([#13669](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13669))

### Removed

- A session that calls one of the removed chat-binding tools (`thread_bind`, `thread_unbind`, `thread_rebind`, `thread_bindings`) now gets a plain unknown-tool answer; the hint about them is gone. ([#14042](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14042)) ([#14141](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14141))

### Added

- `omo account store enable` keeps the sign-in in OmO's own keychain on a Mac whose login keychain stays locked, for example when another macOS user holds the screen or omo runs over SSH. The store is opt-in. `disable` moves the sign-in back, and `status` reports which store is in use. omo never changes the keychain search list or the default keychain, and never falls back between stores. ([#14033](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14033))

name: CC Switch v4.0.35
body:
# CC Switch v4.0.35

本版本让 Claude Code / Claude Desktop 里用 ChatGPT 账号的 Codex 卡片能用上 **GPT-6.2**，会话管理里可以看到 Codex `/goal` 的**完整目标**，请求详情里的请求 ID 可以**一键复制**。

另外修复了 Claude Code 的 auto 模式在关不掉思考的模型上被整体拦下；Codex 聚合模式和「打开终端」报 Responses-Lite 需要 `reasoning.context`；Codex 压缩上下文后第一条请求被拒；用量页自定义日期选到很早的年份时卡死；Skill 的托管副本不在了就卸载不掉等问题。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.35-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.35-ja.md)**

---

## 新增

### 会话管理里显示 Codex `/goal` 的完整目标

目标超过 700 字节时，Codex 注入的上下文里不写目标内容，会话管理里也就看不到目标（见 [#9647](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9647)）。现在从会话记录里读出完整目标，显示成一步「目标 · 状态」，展开即是完整内容；目标和状态都没变的重复记录不再显示。

### 请求详情里可以复制完整的请求 ID

请求详情里过长的值会被省略号截断，像 Codex 的 `resp_...` 这类长请求 ID 没法完整复制去对日志（见 [#9681](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9681)）。现在请求 ID 后面多了一个复制按钮。

### 新增 GPT-6.2 Sol / Astra 的价格

按官方标准档（272K 以内）的价格计费；长上下文档、Batch / Fast 等档位和 GPT-6 一样暂不区分。

---

## 修复

- **Claude Code / Claude Desktop 里用 ChatGPT 账号的 Codex 卡片获取不到 GPT-6.2，手动填了也报「not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account」**（[#9678](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9678)，见 [#9670](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9670)）：OpenAI 按 Codex 客户端版本决定给哪些模型，CC Switch 报的版本太旧。现在按 Codex 0.169.0 请求，没有写死任何模型 ID。
- **Claude Code 的 auto 模式在关不掉思考的模型上，Bash、MCP 等工具调用全部被拒**（见 [#8887](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8887)、[#9671](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9671)）：auto 模式的判断请求要求关闭思考，MiniMax-M3.1-Flash 这类模型直接报 400，Claude Code 就认为判断服务不可用。现在经路由时（Claude Code 和 Claude Desktop），Anthropic 格式的上游这样报错会去掉关闭思考的字段，在同一家重试一次。上游本来接受的请求原样发送，不影响缓存。
- **Codex 聚合模式下报「Responses-Lite requires `reasoning.context` to be `all_turns`」，同一家直连和路由都正常**（见 [#9665](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9665)）：卡片没写模型目录时，聚合模式改用和直连一样的 GPT-6 官方设置。从卡片「打开终端」时出现的同一个报错也一并修好。
- **Codex 经路由转成 Chat 格式时，压缩上下文后第一条请求被要求严格的网关以「message content cannot be empty」拒绝**（见 [#9660](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9660)）：压缩时只含图片的用户消息会变成空消息，现在转成 Chat 格式时去掉内容为空的用户消息，其他消息不变。
- **用量页自定义日期的起点选到 1905 年这类很早的年份时，客户端卡死**（见 [#9691](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9691)）：现在只能选从第一条用量记录到今天之间的日期，范围外的日期不可选，手动输入的也会被拉回范围内。
- **Skill 的托管副本已经不在时卸载不掉**（[#9669](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9669)，见 [#9668](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9668)）。

---

## 致谢

感谢 @imfuxiao（Codex 卡片支持 GPT-6.2）、@Maharramoff（卸载托管副本已不在的 Skill）、@SaladDay（拆分本地路由的转发代码、数据库访问改用应用类型）的贡献。

特别感谢以下贡献者：你们的 PR 发现并修复了真实的问题，只是同样的问题后来在主线上另行修好，PR 因此关闭。@xunapro（[#4262](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/4262)，同类 PR 里最早提出 S3 服务商选择没被记住、阿里云 OSS / 腾讯云 COS 因路径式地址报 403）、@mercutiojohn（[#8547](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8547)，找准了 Gemini CLI 供应商获取模型列表失败的三个原因）。

感谢 @chencyan364、@DemosHume、@LAN-SHH、@mouse8867、@leafsnow、@zhuqiang1248、@ramonmi、@zx2121651、@VICCC-0x90 提出需求、报告问题和提供复现信息。

完整的技术细节请见 [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)。

body:
### Highlights

- **GPT-6.2 Prompt Caching**: GPT-6.2 models don't cache a system prompt sent in the Responses `instructions` field, so every step re-billed it as uncached input. OpenCode now sends it as a leading developer message on every Responses route, including OpenAI (API key and ChatGPT sign-in), GitHub Copilot, Zen, Azure and OpenRouter, so it is cached from the second step on. ([#64542](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64542), [#64544](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64544))

### Core

#### Bug fixes

- Fixed GPT-6.2 models re-billing the system prompt as uncached input on every step. On GitHub Copilot `gpt-6.2-sol`, uncached input per step dropped from about 14,000 tokens to 3. Compaction through `/responses/compact` now reads the same cached prefix. ([#64542](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64542), [#64544](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64544))
- `webfetch` structured output no longer repeats the `url` and `format` it was called with. ([#64534](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64534))

name: v2.3.1
body:
### Highlights

- **Timed-Out Shell Commands Keep Running**: A shell command still running when its timeout expires now moves to the background instead of being killed, so long builds and test runs finish and report back. A foreground `timeout: 0` now means the default 120 seconds. ([#63699](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63699))
- **Compaction Without the Wait**: As a session nears automatic compaction, the summary is now written in the background, so your next prompt doesn't pause for it. Set `compaction.background: false` to turn it off; a background summary that ends up unused still costs tokens. ([#64290](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64290))
- **GPT 6.2 with ChatGPT Sign-In**: GPT 6.2 Sol and GPT 6.2 Astra, plus their fast variants, now show up in the model picker when you sign in with ChatGPT. ([#64508](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64508))
- **Update Plugins from Settings**: Open **Settings › Extensions**, click **Check for updates**, then **Update** on any plugin with a new version. ([#64511](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64511))
- **Comment on Selected Code**: Selecting code in diff and file viewers now just selects it, so you can copy it, and an **Add comment** toolbar appears beside the selection. ([#64410](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64410))

### Core

#### Improvements

- Shell commands still running when their timeout expires now move to the background instead of being killed, in every build. The `shell_timeout_background` flag is gone; configs that still set it keep loading. A foreground `timeout: 0` now uses the default 120 second timeout instead of waiting until the command exits. ([#63699](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63699))
- Background compaction is now on by default: as a session nears automatic compaction, the summary is written in the background so the next prompt doesn't wait for it. Turn it off with `compaction.background: false`; a background summary that is never used still costs tokens. The `experimental.background_compaction` setting is removed. ([#64290](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64290))
- OpenCode again reads `CLAUDE.md` in any directory that has no `AGENTS.md`, and falls back to `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` when the global `AGENTS.md` is missing. This also applies to instructions found when the agent reads nested files. Set `OPENCODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_CODE` or `OPENCODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT` to skip every `CLAUDE.md`. ([#64474](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64474), [#64533](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64533))
- Added GPT 6.2 Sol and GPT 6.2 Astra, plus their fast variants, to the ChatGPT model list. ([#64508](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64508))
- `websearch` now returns a flat list of results, each with its `url`, `title`, `content` and `published` date. ([#64471](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64471))
- Code Mode and plugins get a simpler structured result from `read`: `text` (with `offset`, `lineCount` and `next`), `directory` (entry names) or `media` (a URI instead of base64). What the model sees is unchanged. ([#64361](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64361))
- Code Mode programs can use Node's `Buffer` for encoding and decoding bytes. ([#64365](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64365))
- In Code Mode, `search("issues")` now works as shorthand for `search({ query: "issues" })`. ([#64347](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64347))
- Code Mode tool summaries in the catalog can now be up to 500 characters instead of 120, so the model sees more of each tool's description. ([#64341](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64341))
- The `glob` and `grep` tools now report a malformed filename glob (for example `[`) as an error that names the parameter to fix, instead of returning no results. ([#63960](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63960))
- Server requests that crash now return a 500 with a readable JSON `UnknownError` body instead of an empty one. Storage problems name the cause (for example "Storage is full" or "Storage is read-only"); other crashes include a `ref` you can find in the server log. ([#64022](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64022))
- The shell tool description now tells the model that its session ID is in the `OPENCODE_SESSION_ID` environment variable. ([#63718](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63718))
- Experimental schedules are now automations, behind the `automations` flag (the old `schedules` flag still works). An automation runs on a time, an interval, a cron or a pushed MCP event, and either sends a prompt (to the creating session, another session or a new subagent) or runs a Code Mode program that decides whether to send one. Use `/automation` or the `automation_*` tools. Active or paused plain prompt schedules carry over; schedules with a condition or run limit, and finished ones, are dropped. ([#64160](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64160))

#### Bug fixes

- Fixed finished shell commands leaving zombie processes under `opencode-pty`. The process daemon now cleans each command up when it exits. Background processes started by a successful command (`cmd &`) keep running, and a failed command's leftovers are stopped. ([#64266](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64266), [#64251](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64251))
- Fixed ChatGPT and OpenAI subscription logins losing their sharing-limit safeguards and context caps when a token refresh failed. ([#64470](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64470))
- Fixed Claude Agent models falling back to a 200K context window when Claude Code adds or renames a model. Thanks @Tarquinen. ([#64107](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64107))
- Fixed requests being rejected after switching models mid-session on OpenAI-compatible providers. Models that declare a different reasoning field (such as `reasoning_content`) no longer receive `reasoning_details` from earlier turns. ([#64243](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64243))
- Rejecting a permission request now rejects only the other pending requests from the same step, not every pending request in the session. ([#64343](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64343))
- Fixed a finished subagent being reported to its parent as still running when its answer quoted the "Background work still running" heading. ([#64026](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64026))
- Fixed ACP clients missing turns that a background shell woke after the original turn ended. ([#64262](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64262))
- Reading a small text file now applies the default line and byte limits, so a short file with very many lines is paged instead of returned whole. ([#63810](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63810))
- Paged reads that select a single blank line now return that line instead of an empty result. ([#63809](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63809))
- `read` now rejects `limit: 0` with "Limit must be a positive integer". ([#63808](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63808))
- Text files that start with `BM` are no longer mistaken for BMP images, and only real `GIF87a`/`GIF89a` headers count as GIFs, so these files read as text again. ([#63822](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63822), [#63811](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63811))
- Fixed shell output pages, grep previews, generated titles, read lines and shell output tails splitting emoji and other multi-byte characters, which showed up as `�`. ([#63984](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63984), [#63967](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63967))
- Shell commands using unknown ANSI-C escapes such as `$'\q'` are now read the same way Bash and Zsh read them, so permission rules can match them. ([#64263](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64263))
- Session title search is now case-insensitive for non-ASCII letters, such as Cyrillic and accented text. ([#64259](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64259))
- Fixed `grep` results being dropped when a matching line or path is not valid UTF-8. Thanks @Tarquinen. ([#62249](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62249))
- The `@` file picker now finds files in hidden folders such as `.github/` and dotfiles such as `.env.example` when file search uses ripgrep (the default on Windows and outside git repos). `.git` and gitignored files stay excluded. Thanks @Tarquinen. ([#62577](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62577))
- An unreachable well-known integration source is now skipped instead of dropping every well-known source. Thanks @Tarquinen. ([#62578](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62578))
- A corrupt cached project ID is now ignored instead of being used. Thanks @Tarquinen. ([#62576](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62576))
- Plugin tool renames from `tool.execute.before` now apply to calls inside Code Mode programs, and a renamed call returns the new tool's structured result. ([#63633](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63633), [#64333](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64333))
- In Code Mode, calling a tool that doesn't exist now returns a rejected promise, so `.catch` and `Promise.allSettled` can handle it instead of the whole script failing. ([#64510](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64510))
- A Code Mode program that only logs no longer shows a stray `null` line before its logs. ([#64344](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64344))

### TUI

#### Improvements

- Permission prompts from a subagent, and from that subagent's own subagents, now appear while you view the subagent's session. Prompts also show in front of an open composer. ([#64343](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64343))
- The export dialog under the new designs can save to the system temp directory as well as the project folder. Thanks @Tarquinen. ([#62490](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62490))
- Removed time to first token (ttft) from the assistant message footer. Tokens per second still shows when `session.tps` is on. ([#63759](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63759))

#### Bug fixes

- When another TUI sharing your tabs closes the session you're viewing, closing it here now moves to the neighbouring tab. ([#64261](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64261))
- Fixed broken characters at the edges of the shell output viewer and the inline shell display when output is long. ([#63967](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63967), [#63984](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63984))

### Desktop

#### Improvements

- You can check for and install plugin package updates from **Settings › Extensions**. Use **Check for updates** to look for new versions, then click **Update** on any plugin that has one. ([#64511](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64511), [#64525](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64525))
- Selecting code in diff and file viewers now just selects text, so you can copy it. An **Add comment** toolbar appears next to the selection to comment on those lines; line numbers and the gutter `+` still start a comment directly. ([#64410](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64410))
- Cmd+F (Ctrl+F) now finds text in Markdown, Mermaid, CSV and HTML previews in the side panel, using the same find bar as the code view. ([#63663](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63663))
- Disconnecting a provider or removing an account in **Settings → Providers** now asks for confirmation first. Disconnecting OpenCode Console says how many providers will stop working. ([#64212](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64212))
- The model picker's variant flyout now follows the keyboard: it opens beside the highlighted row, `→` enters it to pick a variant or toggle Favorite, and `←` or `Escape` goes back. A model's Console budget and reset time now show in the flyout. ([#64409](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64409), [#64423](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64423))
- When **New worktree** is selected for a new session, the composer shows the base branch (`from dev ▾`). Click it to pick another base; the choice applies immediately, and **Use main checkout** switches back. ([#64228](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64228))
- Redesigned the folder picker for remote servers, with a path bar, up to three recent-project pills plus a **More projects** menu, and a search box that shows the selected folder. ([#64241](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64241))
- ` ```latex ` and ` ```math ` code fences now render as display math once complete. ([#64380](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64380))
- The new icon set is now the default, and the **New icons** experiment has been removed. ([#64466](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64466), [#64451](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64451))
- The copy button under assistant messages is now always visible. Message metadata still appears on hover. ([#64478](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64478))
- Text files opened in side-panel tabs now have the same copy and download actions as other files. ([#64463](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64463))
- **Manage models** now shows every provider as a card with a `⋯` menu, whether or not you're signed in to OpenCode Console. ([#64235](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64235))
- The connect provider dialog has a cleaner layout for every sign-in step: breadcrumbs, method icons, full-width device codes, and a "Signing in from another device?" row for pasting a redirect URL. ([#63829](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63829))
- **Collapse long messages** is no longer experimental. It is now a setting under **Timeline** preferences. ([#64441](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64441))
- Settings now opens on your client preferences, which are listed first, pairing is grouped with Servers, and there's a **Help & feedback** link. ([#64440](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64440), [#64220](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64220))
- Automatic compactions now always show as a single quiet divider; manual and failed compactions still show the full record. ([#64290](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64290))
- Pairing QR codes can carry a server name, which becomes the paired server's default name. ([#64139](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64139))
- Image attachment thumbnails are larger, with a 3:2 crop, and a failed image no longer moves the message below it when retried. ([#64215](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64215))
- The Hex voice tip no longer appears when Hex is already installed, its copy now says what Hex is, and tips wait an hour after first launch before the first one shows. ([#64130](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64130), [#64131](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64131), [#63974](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63974), [#63760](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63760))
- Added missing translations for every non-English language, about 920 strings each. ([#64205](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64205))

#### Bug fixes

- Fixed the desktop app failing to start when `drafts.sqlite` was a symlink to or copy of the CLI's `opencode.db`. The desktop now moves that file aside and creates its own, leaving the CLI database untouched. ([#64203](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64203))
- Switching session tabs with a keyboard shortcut now focuses the composer. ([#64418](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64418))
- Long prompts now stay folded while a new session is being created. ([#64452](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64452))
- On macOS, the browser pane stays live while you resize panels instead of showing a still image. ([#64443](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64443))
- Submenus now open one at a time and swap without blinking, and stay open while you move the pointer across other items to reach them. ([#63739](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63739))
- Pressing a button now dismisses its tooltip until you hover it again, and copy buttons show "Copied" for two seconds, including in the `/btw` panel. ([#63834](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63834))
- Dialogs now use consistent sizes, corner radius and row styles across the command palette, session search, model picker, location picker and other lists. ([#63432](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63432), [#64216](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64216), [#64206](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64206))
- Sessions on OpenCode Go no longer show a $0.00 cost. ([#63744](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63744))
- **Use main checkout** now stays on one line in the branch picker, and wrapped question descriptions have better spacing. ([#64450](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64450), [#64446](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64446))
- Restyled the **Timeline detail** slider and visibility buttons in settings so they read as clickable. ([#64186](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64186))
- Polished small details: animated counts no longer look faded at rest, the sidebar resize pill is hidden, the sidebar peek insets match, subagent breadcrumbs show a hover background, and screen readers name the redirect URL field after its label only. ([#64155](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64155), [#64219](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64219), [#64192](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64192), [#63742](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63742), [#63885](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63885))

### SDK

#### Improvements

- Unhandled server errors now return a JSON `UnknownError` body (`message` and `ref`) with status 500 instead of an empty body. ([#64022](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64022))
- Experimental automation endpoints replace the schedule endpoints: `/api/experimental/automation` and `client.experimental.automation.*` (`create`, `list`, `get`, `pause`, `resume`, `delete`). `/api/experimental/schedule` and `client.experimental.schedule.*` are removed. ([#64160](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64160))
- Config adds `compaction.background`; `experimental.background_compaction` and the `shell_timeout_background` flag are removed. ([#64290](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64290), [#63699](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63699))

#### Bug fixes

- Apps embedding the SDK with an in-memory database no longer import the user's legacy `auth.json` credentials. Only a database file opened by path imports them. ([#63716](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63716))

### Extensions

#### Improvements

- Each tool call inside a Code Mode program now has its own call ID in plugin hooks and traces. Its permission requests still show on the `execute` call's row. ([#64324](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64324))
- Plugin `SessionIdleBackground` items can now be `{ kind: "codemode", sessionID, jobID }`, and GUI plugin `BridgeLayout` accepts an optional `clip` rectangle. ([#64343](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64343), [#63819](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63819))

#### Bug fixes

- The browser extension's URL bar action buttons are now spaced 6px apart. ([#64214](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64214))

Skills that produce visuals read an existing brand file, and point to Zach Stevens' [design-skills](https://github.com/zstvns/design-skills) for the design work (#990).

It applies only if that library is installed. Descriptions are unchanged.
